Faq.title: Questions and answers.
Faq.intro: Ten questions about the request, the fleet and the terms.
Faq.metaDescription: Ten answers about the request, prices, the fleet, documents, insurance and pickup.

items.question: Is a request a booking?
items.answer: No. It is a quote request. The rental is completed only after we confirm availability, terms and the final cost in writing.

items.question: Why can't I see prices?
items.answer: We do not publish prices before the owner approves them. You will receive the final cost together with the terms before anything is committed.

items.question: Can I choose a specific car?
items.answer: You can state a preference. Availability of that exact vehicle is confirmed separately. The fleet, photographs and specifications are illustrative.

items.question: Where is pickup?
items.answer: The location and exact address are pending confirmation. We do not publish an address that has not been verified.

items.question: What documents will I need?
items.answer: Usually a driving licence and an identity document. Exact requirements — age, licence category, years held — are confirmed before the rental.

items.question: What about insurance and deposit?
items.answer: Insurance terms, the deposit amount and any excess are confirmed in writing before anything is committed. We do not publish terms that have not been approved.

items.question: Does the request cost anything?
items.answer: No. The request is free and requires no payment, card or deposit.

items.question: Can I change or cancel my request?
items.answer: Contact us with the request reference. Cancellation terms will be published after approval.

items.question: Are the fleet cars real?
items.answer: The fleet is illustrative. Photographs are licensed reference images and not necessarily the business's vehicles. The final list and photographs will be replaced after owner confirmation.

items.question: When will the site be complete?
items.answer: We are preparing it. Contact details, terms and the final fleet will be published only after confirmation.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: How we collect and use the data you send us with a request.
Privacy.metaDescription: Draft privacy policy: data, purpose, legal basis, retention, sharing, cookies, rights and security.
Privacy.notice: Draft — pending legal review and owner confirmation.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: Through the request form we collect only what you provide: name, email, phone, dates, pickup and vehicle preference and, optionally, a message.

The hosting platform may keep standard technical logs (IP address, timestamp, requested URL and response status) for security and reliability. The application does not log the content of your request.
bullets: We do not collect payment data; the form does not ask for a card.
We do not request identity documents through the form.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: The data is used only to answer your request, check availability and agree the terms before anything is committed.
It is not used for advertising or automated decision-making.

sections.title: Legal basis
paragraphs: Processing is based on your consent, given when you submit the request.
You can withdraw it at any time; withdrawal does not affect processing that has already taken place.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: The retention period is pending owner confirmation. Until it is set, requests are kept only as long as needed to answer them.
Once the period is set, it will be published on this page.

sections.title: Sharing
paragraphs: Data is shared only with the delivery provider that transmits the request (email or webhook).
It is not sold and not passed to third parties for advertising.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We do not use analytics or advertising cookies, and no analytics tool is currently active.
If a technical cookie becomes necessary for the page to work, it will be strictly essential.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, portability and object.
You may also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority. In Greece this is the Hellenic Data Protection Authority.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: The following measures are in place:
bullets: Rate limiting per IP address and a global limit.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Contact details for data-protection matters are pending confirmation and are not published yet. Until then, use the request form.

RentalTerms.title: Rental terms
RentalTerms.intro: The terms below are a draft. Every topic will be confirmed in writing before the rental.
RentalTerms.metaDescription: Draft rental terms: driver, documents, deposit, insurance, fuel, mileage, cancellation, damage, pickup and vehicle substitution.
RentalTerms.notice: Draft — pending legal review and owner confirmation.

sections.title: Driver eligibility
paragraphs: The minimum age, the licence required and the years of experience will be confirmed in writing before the rental.
We do not publish numbers that have not been approved.

sections.title: Required documents
paragraphs: Usually a driving licence and an identity document are required. The exact list will be confirmed in writing before the rental.

sections.title: Deposit
paragraphs: The deposit amount and payment method will be confirmed in writing before the rental.
We do not publish amounts.

sections.title: Insurance
paragraphs: Coverage, excess and any optional extras will be confirmed in writing before the rental.
We do not publish coverage terms that have not been approved.

sections.title: Fuel
paragraphs: The fuel policy at pickup and return will be confirmed in writing before the rental.

sections.title: Mileage
paragraphs: The mileage limit or policy will be confirmed in writing before the rental.
We do not publish limits.

sections.title: Cancellation
paragraphs: The request is free. The rental's cancellation terms will be confirmed in writing before the rental.

sections.title: Damage
paragraphs: The damage reporting process and any charges will be confirmed in writing before the rental.
We do not publish amounts.

sections.title: Pickup and return
paragraphs: The location, exact address and pickup and return hours are pending confirmation. They will be given in writing before the rental.

sections.title: Vehicle substitution
paragraphs: If the vehicle you requested is unavailable, we will propose an alternative category and agree the terms in writing before anything is committed.
